title: Relay Spire
kicker: A slim, windswept relay tower with a beacon at the top that has lately begun to burn thin.
hook: A slim, windswept relay tower with a beacon at the top that has lately begun to burn thin.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The Relay Spire is distant enough to be a future problem and bright enough that nobody can pretend it is unrelated.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: A slim tower that exists to be high and bright. The base room is all coiled rope, spare flags, and worn-out boots. The outer stair winds up into hard wind. At the top a beacon burns, and lately it burns a little thin, the kind of detail nobody mentions and...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: Whoever keeps the beacon lives on what they can haul up, hard rations, a thermos of something hot, courier-bird eggs when the nests are generous. They share a cup at the top and watch the horizon over the rim of it.
